2026_02_SEA_ARI.headline: Backup-quarterback test meets an Arizona team with fresh momentum
2026_02_SEA_ARI.paragraph1: Seattle heads to Arizona with Drew Lock expected to start after Sam Darnold’s hip injury, while the Cardinals return home with fresh confidence after upsetting the Chargers in their opener. Sports Illustrated reports that Darnold is expected to miss Week 2 and that Lock will take over, while Yahoo’s matchup report describes Arizona’s strong first impression. The Seahawks need Lock to keep the offense on schedule; the Cardinals can make the quarterback change matter by forcing Seattle into obvious passing situations.
2026_02_SEA_ARI.model_rationale: Seattle’s protection and early-down execution with Drew Lock determine whether the Seahawks can stay balanced or Arizona can turn the quarterback change into a structural advantage.
